Reads twin proved by standalone probe driving the real `appendRead` (the test file cannot load pre-fix, it imports the new `READS_MARKER_BYTES`): pre-fix `racer copies live=0 sibling=0`, shipped `live=1 sibling=0`; row read-trace.test.mjs:236 passes in-suite (suite.txt:2108).

truths.truth: The admission check reserves the mandatory rotation marker, so a near-bound pending record never leaves the fresh record over its bound on the first write - on both records
truths.evidence: Probe through the real `appendEvent`/`appendRead` at a padded root, pending line sized MAX-8. Pre-fix library: trace `written=true size=1048822 bound=1048576 over=246`, reads `written=true size=8388682 bound=8388608 over=74` (the 74 B matches CONTEXT D-01's measurement). Shipped: trace `written=false reason=oversized-event`, reads `written=false reason=oversized-record`, record left at MAX-1 in both, nothing rotated. Guard against over-tightening is real too: the row 'an event that DOES fit beside the marker rotates under the bound (AC2)' (trace.test.mjs:860) passes pre-fix AND post-fix. Pre-fix the refusal rows fail: 'an event with no room BESIDE the marker is refused, not rotated for' -> AssertionError.

truths.truth: A leftover-generation eviction that cannot confirm the claim it published puts the generation back, and the writer's own event still lands in the live record - both records
truths.evidence: Pre-fix run of trace.test.mjs:385 ('a LEFTOVER eviction that cannot confirm its claim puts the generation back (D-02)') -> AssertionError 'the generation was destroyed by an eviction that could not confirm its claim'; passes on shipped code. Reads arm by standalone probe (undatable sidecar: `mkdirSync(readsClaimPath(d))`): pre-fix `generation-intact=false`, shipped `generation-intact=true`, `written=true`, own record in the live file, no `.evict` temp left behind. Row read-trace.test.mjs:431 passes in-suite.

truths.truth: The seal the marker carries is a real value written by one seam and consumed by the other - it states the generation's byte size and is what the next rotation's rescue reads from
truths.evidence: End-to-end on the doubly-rotated root: `.planning/reads.jsonl` marker carries "carried_bytes":8388607 and `stat -c%s reads.1.jsonl` is 8388607; both trace markers carry "carried_bytes":1048575 against a 1048575-byte trace.1.jsonl. Consumed at lib/trace.mjs:1012-1050 (newest marker scanned backwards, non-numeric/negative rejected) and lib/read-trace.mjs:869-893 via `sealOf(sibling)`; the consumption is what makes truth 1's probe land the racer at live=1. No debt markers (TODO/FIXME/HACK/placeholder) on any of the four touched files - the only XXXX hits are secret-redaction test fixtures in read-trace.test.mjs.

truths.truth: The goal's second clause holds on every arm: after a second rotation the tail is complete, or the shortfall is stated
truths.evidence: Probe on the shipped library: a live record whose marker is v3.7.7-shaped ({ts,event,file}, no carried_bytes) plus a leftover generation carrying one racing record, driven through the real `rotateReads` -> `return={"rotated":true}  racer-in-live=false  racer-in-sibling=false`. The record is in neither file and nothing is stated. The guard is `if (at !== null)` at lib/read-trace.mjs:869 with no else, same shape at lib/trace.mjs:1027, both falling through to `return shortfall === undefined ? { rotated: true } : ...` (read-trace.mjs:898, trace.mjs:1056). Documented deliberately at read-trace.mjs:851-854 ('NO SEAL, NO RESCUE ... It fails closed') and named in SUMMARY.md Open items.

gaps.name: A generation whose marker carries no seal is destroyed with nothing stated
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the goal's second clause ('or the shortfall is stated') does not hold on the no-seal arm. Where the leftover generation was sealed by pre-phase code (a v3.7.7 marker has no carried_bytes) or by a corrupt marker line, no rescue runs, the generation is unlinked, and the rotation returns a clean {rotated: true}. Measured: a racing record in that generation ends up in NEITHER file with no shortfall reported.
gaps.evidence: lib/read-trace.mjs:869 `if (at !== null) {` has no else and falls through to :898 `return shortfall === undefined ? { rotated: true } : ...`; identical shape at lib/trace.mjs:1027 and :1056. The choice is stated deliberately at lib/read-trace.mjs:851-854. Probe through the real `rotateReads` with a v3.7.7-shaped marker: `return={"rotated":true}  racer-in-live=false  racer-in-sibling=false`. Already named in .planning/phases/5/SUMMARY.md Open items and ruled `downgraded` by the plan-2 risk_surface review; no regression, since before this phase every leftover generation died silently. It is the one arm of the phase goal that is not delivered, and it fires on the first rotation after an upgrade rather than only in theory.
gaps.missing: Set `shortfall = null` on the no-seal arm in both `rotateTrace` (lib/trace.mjs, the missing else on :1027) and `rotateReads` (lib/read-trace.mjs, the missing else on :869), so an unreadable seal states 'cut by an unknown amount' the way the failed-stat arm already does, plus one row per record asserting `res.shortfall === null` for a marker with no `carried_bytes`.
